title: The home's first band and its instruments
summary: Visiting his brother, Foster practiced with the new band: snare, tub bass drum, clarinet, two trumpets, bass horn; Rene on clarinet, Smoot on cornet, George Washington on trombone.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons
